hypothesis: Observed self-contact evidence repairs the unidentified alias ratio without adding parameters or losing learned distinct-role continuation.

arms.alias: Identical evidence except contacts in first two eligible single-contact lineages per N; both reversed views become self contacts on their own first operand.

substitution.eligibility: Different PRECONTACT operand bits, determined from anchor plus optional leading set only. Never select on hidden mode or contact outcome.
substitution.starting_bits: Two zero and two one per N; retain dependence of the two views of each lineage.
substitution.matched: Initialization, episode IDs, action kinds/counts, sensor coverage, masks, visible bits, batch geometry, updates and CPU ceilings; actual consumed compute measured.
substitution.changed: Contact alias structure and consequential subsequent observed values only.

evaluation.self_canonical_exclusions: Both training tapes, reserved splits, within-bank duplicates, historical continuation-v1 self-contact blueprints.
evaluation.self_partition: in_family in combined plan; action exposure differs deliberately between arms
evaluation.oracle: Existing independently coded conditional oracle under supplied binary-contact-v1 law; same-author public custody.
evaluation.historical_canonical_overlap: Reported descriptively for the whole bank, not hidden or claimed absent.

analysis.retention: Zero newly wrong continuation queries relative to paired ordinary control; >=95% continuation accuracy and role-pair conjunction, full support, zero unchanged-bit errors.
analysis.self: At least95% exact each starting bit per seed, full support and no unchanged-bit errors.
analysis.proper_scores: Raw joint NLL/Brier/ECE10; zero truth probability retains infinite NLL, abstention missing proper score.
analysis.missing_forecasts: Incorrect on every planned denominator; never delete failure suffixes.
analysis.inferential_scope: Descriptive five-seed paired intervention on one public bank; no population significance test or independent-world generalization claim.

decision_order: STOP_INCOMPLETE_EXECUTION if any unknown failure, incomplete inventory, interrupted execution, invalid identity or unequal prescribed updates
REVISE_EVIDENCE_FIX if any candidate self/continuation/support/preservation/retention criterion fails
KEEP_EVIDENCE_FIX if mean self gain >=0.20 and positive for every seed
